input.quote: Commerce One grants to Corio a nonexclusive, nontransferable (except in accordance with Section 14.1 of this Agreement), royalty-free, fully paid up, perpetual right and license in the Territory to reproduce, install and use additional copies of the Software and Software tools and utilities, subject to any restrictions placed on the Commerce One by third party software providers, in machine executable object code for (i) Corio's internal business operations and (ii) production, testing, development, upgrade, reporting and training.
input.rationale: The Section 2 grants are strong on two of the three material terms: the hosting licence is expressly "perpetual and irrevocable" and the internal use licence is royalty-free, fully paid up and perpetual, so the licence is not revocable at Commerce One's discretion; and Section 14.1 permits assignment to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets without consent (subject only to a direct-competitor carve-out), meeting the successor-transfer element. The gap is affiliate/contractor coverage: no grant names Corio's affiliates, the word "Affiliate" appears nowhere in the agreement, and the internal use licence is confined to "Corio's internal business operations", with no written-notice or other path to add affiliates. That fails the fallback requirement that affiliates be covered on written notice, so we propose the minimal edit extending Section 2.2 to Corio's affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf (contractor hosting is already partly covered by the "owned or operated by or for Corio" definition of Corio Servers) and confirming irrevocability. We have not treated the "nontransferable" label as a separate issue given the Section 14.1 carve-out.

ops.oldText: Commerce One grants to Corio a nonexclusive, nontransferable (except in accordance with Section 14.1 of this Agreement), royalty-free, fully paid up, perpetual right and license in the Territory
ops.newText: Commerce One grants to Corio, its affiliates and its contractors acting on Corio's behalf a nonexclusive, nontransferable (except in accordance with Section 14.1 of this Agreement), royalty-free, fully paid up, perpetual and irrevocable right and license in the Territory
for (i) the internal business operations of Corio and its affiliates

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended the internal use licence to Corio's affiliates and to contractors acting on Corio's behalf, and confirmed it is irrevocable, consistent with our playbook position that licence scope follow our operating group. If preferred, we can accept affiliate coverage on written notice to Commerce One.
proposal.summary: Extend the internal use licence in Section 2.2 to Corio affiliates and contractors and make it irrevocable.
